import subprocess, re, statistics, itertools
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path('.').resolve()
BASE = Path('/tmp/simplify-baseline')
NEW = REPO / 'build-release' / 'simplify'
CORE = re.compile(r'SIMPLIFY_CORE_MS:\s*([\d.]+)')
PTS = re.compile(r'SIMPLIFIED_POINTS:\s*(\d+)')
DIST = re.compile(r'^(?:Frechet distance:\s*)?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)$', re.M)

ids = [1, 2, 3, 5, 8]
eps_deltas = [
    (0.5, 200),
    (0.25, 400),
    (2.0, 100),
    (5.0, 50),
    (10.0, 200),
    (299.0, 1.0),
]

def run(bin, idv, e, d, dist=False, repeats=1):
    cmd = [str(bin), '--in', str(idv), '-e', str(e), '-d', str(d), '--time']
    if dist:
        cmd += ['--out', '--dist']
    times, pts, dists = [], [], []
    for _ in range(repeats):
        p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
        if p.returncode != 0:
            raise SystemExit(f'fail {bin} id={idv} e={e} d={d}\n{p.stderr[-500:]}\n{p.stdout[-500:]}')
        text = p.stdout + '\n' + p.stderr
        times.append(float(CORE.search(p.stderr).group(1)))
        pts.append(int(PTS.search(p.stderr).group(1)))
        if dist:
            ms = DIST.findall(text)
            # last numeric frechet-looking line; prefer labelled
            lab = re.search(r'Frechet distance:\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', text, re.I)
            if lab:
                dists.append(float(lab.group(1)))
            elif ms:
                dists.append(float(ms[-1]))
            else:
                # julia --raw prints a lone number
                nums = re.findall(r'(?m)^([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)$', p.stdout)
                if not nums:
                    raise SystemExit(f'no dist\nSTDOUT:\n{p.stdout[-800:]}\nSTDERR:\n{p.stderr[-800:]}')
                dists.append(float(nums[-1]))
    return {
        'ms': statistics.median(times),
        'pts': pts[0],
        'dist': dists[0] if dists else None,
        'all_ms': times,
    }

print(f"{'id':>3} {'eps':>7} {'delta':>7} {'b_pts':>6} {'n_pts':>6} {'d_pts':>5} {'b_ms':>8} {'n_ms':>8} {'ratio':>6} {'b_fr':>10} {'n_fr':>10} {'d_fr':>8} st")
ok = True
for idv, (e, d) in itertools.product(ids, eps_deltas):
    # time-only first for points+perf (3 repeats)
    b = run(BASE, idv, e, d, dist=False, repeats=3)
    n = run(NEW, idv, e, d, dist=False, repeats=3)
    dpts = n['pts'] - b['pts']
    ratio = n['ms'] / b['ms'] if b['ms'] else float('inf')
    # Frechet only on a subset to save time
    bfr = nfr = dfr = None
    do_dist = (idv in (1, 2) and (e, d) in ((0.5, 200), (299.0, 1.0), (0.25, 400)))
    if do_dist:
        bd = run(BASE, idv, e, d, dist=True, repeats=1)
        nd = run(NEW, idv, e, d, dist=True, repeats=1)
        bfr, nfr = bd['dist'], nd['dist']
        dfr = nfr - bfr
    status = 'OK'
    if dpts > 0:
        status = 'FAIL_PTS'
        ok = False
    if dfr is not None and dfr > 0.01:
        status = 'FAIL_DIST'
        ok = False
    print(f"{idv:3d} {e:7.2f} {d:7.1f} {b['pts']:6d} {n['pts']:6d} {dpts:5d} {b['ms']:8.3f} {n['ms']:8.3f} {ratio:6.3f} "
          f"{bfr if bfr is not None else float('nan'):10.4f} {nfr if nfr is not None else float('nan'):10.4f} "
          f"{dfr if dfr is not None else float('nan'):8.4f} {status}")

print('OVERALL', 'OK' if ok else 'FAIL')
PY
